## Why Ping Matters
### What Is Ping?
Ping measures the time it takes for a data packet to travel from your device to a game server and back, expressed in milliseconds (ms). Lower ping means faster communication, which translates to quicker reaction times and smoother gameplay. Think of it as the delay between pressing a button and seeing the action on screen.
